subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): expose anonymous Talk activity to plugins

question: Should arbitrary plugins be allowed to observe anonymous, process-wide Talk activity, or must observation be scoped to an explicit owner or declared capability?
rationale: The code can mechanically enforce either model, but choosing whether live conversation timing is globally visible is a durable Plugin SDK trust-policy decision.

options.title: Scope the observer
options.body: Require an explicit capability or owner/session grant and add tests proving unrelated plugins cannot observe another Talk session.

options.title: Approve global anonymous observation
options.body: Keep the all-plugin observer, but document that process-wide Talk timing is intentionally available to every Plugin SDK consumer.

options.title: Defer the SDK surface
options.body: Keep the internal activity mechanism out of the public runtime until the plugin trust model is settled.

recommendation.title: Scope the observer
recommendation.body: Require an explicit capability or owner/session grant and add tests proving unrelated plugins cannot observe another Talk session.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work covers the shared Talk-session owner boundary and this Plugin SDK design.
